extension.summary: View your Immich photos and videos in Kodi
extension.description: Browse the timeline, On this day, people and pets, places, albums and favourites of a self-hosted Immich server, or search by description. Watch them as a slideshow that crossfades and slowly pans and zooms across each photo, with photo details at the press of Info. View only: nothing is changed on the server.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an Immich server that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the Immich project.
extension.news: v0.2.3 - Music keeps playing when a slideshow starts - The API key is hidden while you type it - An address without http:// or https:// uses https, except on the local network - Clearer message when the API key lacks a permission - A dropped or stalled connection shows an error instead of failing v0.2.2 - Rotated photos show upright with full resolution on v0.2.1 - Fix Kodi freezing for minutes when a video stops v0.2.0 - The API key no longer shows up in Kodi's debug log or image cache - Pause and resume videos in the slideshow - Date, place and count share one row under each photo v0.1.1 - Pan and zoom runs at its proper speed on skins such as Confluence ZEITGEIST v0.1.0: initial release - timeline, On this day, people, places, albums, favourites, search, and a pan and zoom slideshow

extension.summary: Play your RomM library with Kodi's built-in emulators
extension.description: Browse the ROM library of a self-hosted RomM server, download games and BIOS files on demand, and play them in Kodi's RetroPlayer using the installed libretro game add-ons.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a RomM server (5.0 or newer) that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the RomM project.
extension.news: v0.2.5 - Downloads and unpacking cut short are redone instead of used half-finished - BIOS files are copied even when the server does not give their size - Clearer errors when the server drops the connection - Stop now cancels pairing - File names from the server stay inside the download folder v0.2.4 - Say when an emulator could not be enabled - Hiding platforms without an emulator keeps those Kodi can install one for v0.2.3 - Offers to install a missing emulator, then starts the game - Install emulator: add more emulators for a platform from the context menu - More emulators and platforms, including the LibreELEC repository cores - Download folder limit is now a share of free disk space v0.2.2 - PlayStation 2 games play with the LRPS2 core - Clearer message when the add-on has no emulator for a platform v0.2.1 - New add-on icon v0.2.0 - Continue playing, backlog, and browsing by genre, region and play status - Favourite, backlog, play status and hide games from the context menu (pair again to allow favourites) - Sort order setting, screenshots, other versions of a game, richer game details - Save sync, play time and activity reporting through a background service - Fix: release years were wrong v0.1.0: initial release - pairing, browsing, download and launch

extension.description: Add-on repository for kel-mo's Kodi add-ons, such as RomM. Installing it lets Kodi find and update these add-ons automatically.

extension.summary: Shows your Home Assistant dashboard in Kodi
extension.description: Brings the contents of the Home Assistant "Home" dashboard into Kodi: your favourites, the light, climate, security, maintenance, weather and energy summaries, and every area grouped by floor. States update live over the WebSocket API, and devices can be switched straight from the couch.

Bringt den Inhalt des Home-Assistant-Dashboards „Home" nach Kodi: deine Favoriten, die Übersichten für Licht, Klima, Sicherheit, Wartung, Wetter und Energie sowie alle Räume nach Etagen gruppiert. Die Zustände aktualisieren sich live über die WebSocket-API, und Geräte lassen sich direkt vom Sofa aus schalten.
extension.news: v1.5.0.1 - Fixed: the dashboard could crash while states were changing - Fixed: camera stills stopped after half an hour with a user name and password - Fixed: the access token was sent to image servers other than Home Assistant - Fixed: a cancelled login or a rejected token left the dashboard reconnecting forever - Fixed: a network blip could force a new login, second factor and all - Fixed: a change made while connecting could be missed - Fixed: an IPv6 address in the Home Assistant URL - Temperatures and numbers take decimals where the entity steps in them; a thermostat holding a range asks for both ends - Summaries follow Home Assistant: the default ones appear even if the shortcut list was never edited, and empty ones are left out - The access token is hidden in the settings
